title: Payments, deposits and credits reach AccountingHub under the payer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a test organization whose invoices go to AccountingHub, and sign in to its AccountingHub company in a second tab.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, which owes nothing else.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Approved, with a part sold at $210.00 and a $50.00 deposit taken under customer B, billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Click Create Invoice.
  4. Pay the $160.00 balance from customer B.
  5. In AccountingHub, open customer B's account.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab shows the $50.00 deposit.

Step 3:

  • The invoice is created with $160.00 left to pay ($210.00 − $50.00).

Step 4:

  • The payment is recorded and the invoice is paid.

Step 5:

  • Customer B's account shows the $50.00 deposit, the $210.00 invoice and the $160.00 payment.
  • Customer A's account shows none of them.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12320 (Story 18, AccountingHub)

  • S18-R5: “Payments, deposits and credits arrive under the Bill To's account.”
  • Key Decisions: “AccountingHub receives the invoice under the Bill To, as QuickBooks does. The invoice, its payments, deposits and credits sit on one customer, and no AccountingHub change is needed.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
